courses.search: Search courses by title or code

detail.noLessons: This course has no lessons yet. Add at least one before you publish it.
detail.noAssignments: Nobody has an open assignment for this course.
detail.publishMessage: Published courses can be taken and assigned, and the assignment rules start creating assignments.

detail.publishMessageNoQuiz: This course has no knowledge test, so learners complete it by opening every lesson. Add quiz questions first if you need proof of understanding. Published courses can be taken and assigned, and the rules start creating assignments.

rules.title: Who must take the course
rules.intro: A rule assigns the course automatically, for example to a department, a job position or new hires. Before you save it, you see who it assigns.
rules.empty: No assignment rules yet. Without a rule, the course is only taken by people who are assigned it or choose it themselves.
rules.draftNote: The course is a draft: rules start assigning when it is published.
rules.roleHint: Access roles decide what someone may do in CoreFlow (for example Auditor). Use Job position for the job someone has.
rules.noPositions: No job positions found. Add them under People.
rules.recurrenceHelp: For an annual programme, enter 12. Leave empty if the course only needs to be taken once (or renewed when it expires).
rules.preview: This assigns the course to {{ count }} people.
rules.previewOne: This assigns the course to 1 person.
rules.previewDetail: People covered by the rule: {{ targeted }}. Already assigned: {{ assigned }}. Valid training already in place: {{ compliant }}.
rules.previewDraft: The course is not published, so nobody is assigned until it is.
rules.duplicate: An identical rule already exists for this course.
rules.undoMessage: The rule stops assigning the course. Its {{ count }} open assignments that nobody has started are withdrawn without a new notification; started ones are kept.
rules.undone: Rule removed. {{ cancelled }} assignments withdrawn, {{ kept }} kept because they were started.
rules.syncHelp: Runs every rule now instead of waiting for the nightly run: new people get their assignments, and renewals are created before certificates expire.
